name: GitHub Copilot
about: Inline suggestions from Copilot, and a chat panel
_about: Two halves. The inline suggestions are real Copilot, bridged to the
`copilot-language-server` that GitHub ships — you need to be signed in
The chat panel is not: Copilot's language server has no conversation
API, so the panel runs whatever `settings.chat.command` points at and
shows what comes back. Point it at something you have.
Then open a Rust or Python file and start typing. Tab takes a
